channel.title: Antiques Road Trip
channel.desc: In the second leg of their road trip, antiques aficionados Ishy Khan and Hettie Jago are charging around Somerset and Bristol in a cool 1968 Porsche 912. It's games galore as Hettie falls for a vintage table ice hockey set, while Ishy sets his sights on a very large helter-skelter fairground game. Between shopping, our pair head to the beach for an artistic challenge that's a little more than just buckets and spades. Then it's off to the auction for even more fun and games.
